title.zh: 卷514 列傳三百一 土司傳三 雲南
title.en: Volume 514 Biographies 301: Native Chieftain Biographies 3: Yunnan
title.raw: 卷514 列傳三百一 土司傳三 雲南

sentences.zh: 雲南古滇國。

translations.literal: Yunnan was anciently the state of Dian.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan was in antiquity the kingdom of Dian.

sentences.zh: 自越巂蠻夷任貴自領太守，漢光武即授以印綬，不以內地官守例之。

translations.literal: From when the barbarian Ren Gui of Yuexi claimed the grand administrator's post on his own, Emperor Guangwu of Han at once granted him seals and ribbons, not treating him by the precedent of officials guarding interior prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuexi tribesman Ren Gui took the grand administrator's post on his own authority, Emperor Guangwu of Han immediately invested him with official seals and cords, without applying the usual rules for administrators in the interior.

sentences.zh: 若爨、若蒙，皆以本土大姓，就官累世，為一方長。

translations.literal: Such clans as Cuan and Meng all relied on great local surnames, taking office generation after generation, and became chiefs of a region.
translations.idiomatic: Clans such as the Cuan and the Meng drew on powerful local lineages, held office for generations, and served as regional leaders.

sentences.zh: 元封梁王於滇，與大理之段分治。

translations.literal: The Yuan enfeoffed the Prince of Liang in Dian, and he ruled separately from the Duan of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan, a Prince of Liang was enfeoffed in Dian and governed apart from the Duan clan of Dali.

sentences.zh: 明破梁王，滅大理，就土官而統馭之，分宣慰使、宣撫使、安撫使、正副長官司、土府、土州以治之。

translations.literal: The Ming defeated the Prince of Liang, destroyed Dali, and governed through native officials, dividing administration among pacification commissioners, pacification superintendents, consolation commissioners, chief offices of first and second rank, native prefectures, and native subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming overthrew the Prince of Liang and extinguished Dali, then ruled through native chieftains, dividing authority among pacification commissioners, superintendents, consolation commissioners, chief offices of the first and second rank, native prefectures, and native departments.

sentences.zh: 清順治十七年，平西王吳三桂定雲南，明永明王走緬甸，以沐府舊地封三桂，永鎮雲南。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing, the Prince of Pingxi Wu Sangui pacified Yunnan; the Yongming Prince of Ming fled to Burma; Sangui was enfeoffed on the old lands of the Mu mansion to guard Yunnan in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of the Shunzhi reign, the Prince of Pingxi, Wu Sangui, secured Yunnan; the Ming Yongming Prince fled to Burma; Sangui was granted the former Mu estate and charged to hold Yunnan in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，撤籓，三桂遂叛。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi the princely establishment was abolished, and Sangui thereupon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Kangxi reign the princely fief was withdrawn, and Sangui rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 三桂死，其孫世璠襲。

translations.literal: Sangui died, and his grandson Shihu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: After Sangui's death his grandson Shihu took over.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，克之，世璠自殺，雲南大定。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was taken; Shihu killed himself, and Yunnan was greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the province was taken; Shihu committed suicide, and Yunnan was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，改土歸流之議起。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yongzheng reign, the proposal to replace native rule with regular administration arose.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongzheng reign the policy of replacing native chieftain rule with regular administration came to the fore.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，先革東川土目，即進圖烏蒙。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year they first abolished the native headmen of Dongchuan, then advanced plans against Wumeng.
translations.idiomatic: That summer they first abolished the native headmen of Dongchuan and then turned to Wumeng.

sentences.zh: 時烏蒙土府祿萬鍾、鎮雄土府隴慶侯皆年少，兵權皆握于其叔祿鼎坤、隴聯星。

translations.literal: At that time Lu Wanzhong of the Wumeng native prefecture and Long Qinghou of the Zhenxiong native prefecture were both young; military power was all held by their uncles Lu Dingkun and Long Lianxing.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wanzhong of Wumeng and Long Qinghou of Zhenxiong were both young; their uncles Lu Dingkun and Long Lianxing held the real military power.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰令總兵劉起元屯東川，招降祿鼎坤。

translations.literal: Ortai ordered Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan to garrison Dongchuan and summon Lu Dingkun to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai stationed Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan at Dongchuan to win Lu Dingkun over.

sentences.zh: 惟祿萬鍾制于漢奸，約鎮雄兵三千攻鼎坤于魯甸，鄂爾泰遣遊擊哈元生敗之；

translations.literal: Only Lu Wanzhong was controlled by a Han traitor; he agreed with three thousand Zhenxiong troops to attack Dingkun at Ludian; Ortai sent Guerrilla Commander Ha Yuansheng to defeat them;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wanzhong, however, was manipulated by a Han collaborator and mustered three thousand Zhenxiong troops to strike Dingkun at Ludian; Ortai sent Guerrilla Commander Ha Yuansheng, who routed them;

sentences.zh: 又檄其相仇之阿底土兵共搗烏蒙，連破關隘，賊遂敗走鎮雄。

translations.literal: He also ordered the mutually hostile Adi native troops jointly to strike Wumeng, breaking pass after pass, and the rebels then fled in defeat to Zhenxiong.
translations.idiomatic: He also directed the mutually hostile Adi native forces to strike Wumeng together; they stormed pass after pass until the rebels fled toward Zhenxiong.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰復招降隴聯星，而鼎坤亦以兵三千攻鎮雄之脅，兩酋皆遁四川，於是兩土府旬日平。

translations.literal: Ortai again summoned Long Lianxing to surrender, while Dingkun also with three thousand troops attacked Zhenxiong's flank; both chiefs fled into Sichuan, and thus the two native prefectures were pacified within ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai won Long Lianxing over as well, while Dingkun led three thousand men against Zhenxiong's flank; both chiefs fled into Sichuan, and the two native prefectures were pacified within ten days.

sentences.zh: 以烏蒙設府，鎮雄設州，又設鎮于烏蒙，控制三屬，由四川改隸雲南，以一事權。

translations.literal: Wumeng was made a prefecture, Zhenxiong a department; a garrison was also established at Wumeng to control three subordinate districts; jurisdiction was transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan to unify authority.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng became a prefecture and Zhenxiong a department; a garrison at Wumeng controlled three subordinate districts; the area was transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan to consolidate authority.

sentences.zh: 其東川法戛土目祿天祐、烏蒙米貼土目祿永孝，尚各據巢患邊。

translations.literal: The Faga native headman of Dongchuan, Lu Tianyou, and the Mitie native headman of Wumeng, Lu Yongxiao, still each held nests and troubled the border.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tianyou, the Faga headman of Dongchuan, and Lu Yongxiao, the Mitie headman of Wumeng, still held strongholds and harassed the frontier.

sentences.zh: 六年春，遣兵破擒法戛，又遣副將郭壽域以兵三百捕米貼賊，逃渡小金沙江，糾四川沙馬司及建昌、涼山各夷倮數千潛回，襲陷官兵。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year troops were sent to defeat and capture Faga; Assistant Regional Commander Guo Shouyu was also sent with three hundred men to capture the Mitie rebels; they fled across the Lesser Jinsha River, rallied several thousand Yi of Shama Subprefecture in Sichuan and of Jianchang and Liangshan, slipped back secretly, and stormed and overthrew the government troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year troops broke Faga and took its leader; Assistant Regional Commander Guo Shouyu led three hundred men after the Mitie rebels, who crossed the Lesser Jinsha, rallied several thousand Yi from Shama in Sichuan and from Jianchang and Liangshan, slipped back in secret, and overwhelmed the government force.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰遣總兵張耀祖、參將哈元生三路搜討。

translations.literal: Ortai sent Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu and Assistant Regional Commander Ha Yuansheng on three routes to search out and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai sent Regional Commander Zhang Yaozu and Assistant Regional Commander Ha Yuansheng on three routes to hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 詔四川建昌、永寧官兵聽鄂爾泰節制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the troops of Jianchang and Yongning in Sichuan to obey Ortai's command.
translations.idiomatic: An edict placed the Jianchang and Yongning forces of Sichuan under Ortai's command.

sentences.zh: 於是自小金沙江外，沙馬、雷波、吞都、黃螂諸土司地，直抵建昌，袤千餘里，皆置營汛，形聯勢控，並擒雷波土司楊明義；

translations.literal: Thereupon from beyond the Lesser Jinsha, the lands of the native chieftains of Shama, Leibo, Tundu, and Huanglang, straight to Jianchang, more than a thousand li in length and breadth, garrison posts were all established, linked in form and controlled in power, and the Leibo native chieftain Yang Mingyi was also captured;
translations.idiomatic: From beyond the Lesser Jinsha through the domains of Shama, Leibo, Tundu, Huanglang, and on to Jianchang—more than a thousand li in extent—garrison posts were set up in a linked network, and the Leibo chieftain Yang Mingyi was captured;

sentences.zh: 而哈元生回軍復敗阿盧土司之眾數千，屯田東川，歲收二萬餘石，課礦歲萬金，資兵餉。

translations.literal: Ha Yuansheng on returning his army again defeated several thousand of the Alu native chieftain's followers, opened military colonies in Dongchuan, collected more than twenty thousand piculs yearly, and levied ten thousand taels of gold yearly from mines to supply military rations.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng, on his return, routed several thousand followers of the Alu chieftain, established military colonies in Dongchuan yielding more than twenty thousand piculs a year, and drew ten thousand taels annually from mines to fund the army.

sentences.zh: 軍甫定，祿鼎坤以功擢河南參將，怏怏失望。

translations.literal: The army had just been settled when Lu Dingkun was promoted for merit to assistant regional commander in Henan, discontent and disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly had order been restored when Lu Dingkun was promoted to assistant regional commander in Henan—a posting that left him resentful and disappointed.

sentences.zh: 其子祿萬福乞回魯甸治產，見總兵劉起元軍律不肅，陰會其舊部謀變。

translations.literal: His son Lu Wanfu begged to return to Ludian to manage his estates; seeing Regional Commander Liu Qiyuan's military discipline lax, he secretly gathered his old followers to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: His son Lu Wanfu asked to return to Ludian to manage family property; seeing Liu Qiyuan's lax discipline, he secretly rallied former followers to plot a revolt.

sentences.zh: 時烏蒙商民萬計，有險可扼，且賊止標弩，無大砲，而劉起元惟媮餒賄和，賊遂陷鎮城，盡戕兵民，遍煽東川、鎮雄及四川涼山蠻數萬叛。

translations.literal: At that time Wumeng had tens of thousands of merchants and civilians; there were defiles that could be held; moreover the rebels had only poisoned bolts and crossbows, no great cannon; yet Liu Qiyuan only stole rations and bribed for peace; the rebels then took the garrison town, slaughtered soldiers and civilians entirely, and incited rebellion among tens of thousands of barbarians of Dongchuan, Zhenxiong, and Liangshan in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng then held tens of thousands of merchants and civilians and defensible passes; the rebels had only poisoned bolts and crossbows, no heavy cannon; yet Liu Qiyuan plundered rations and bought peace with bribes; the rebels seized the garrison town, massacred troops and civilians, and stirred tens of thousands in Dongchuan, Zhenxiong, and Liangshan in Sichuan to revolt.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰奏言：「臣用人僨事，請別簡大臣總督兩省，暫假臣提督，將兵討賊雪憤。

translations.literal: Ortai memorialized, saying: "Your servant's employment of men has ruined affairs; I beg that another great minister be selected to govern both provinces; temporarily lend me the post of provincial military commissioner; I will lead troops to punish the rebels and wash away shame."
translations.idiomatic: Ortai memorialized: "I have mishandled personnel; please appoint another senior minister to govern both provinces; grant me temporarily the post of provincial military commissioner so I may lead troops to crush the rebels and redeem this disgrace."

sentences.zh: 」世宗慰留之。

translations.literal: " The Shizong Emperor comforted him and kept him in post.
translations.idiomatic: " The Yongzheng Emperor comforted him and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰調官兵萬餘，土兵半之，三路進攻。

translations.literal: Ortai mobilized more than ten thousand regular troops, with native troops half that number, advancing on three routes.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai mustered more than ten thousand regular troops and half as many native auxiliaries, advancing on three fronts.

sentences.zh: 先令總兵魏翥國率兵二千，七日馳抵東川，得不陷；

translations.literal: He first ordered Regional Commander Wei Zhuguo to lead two thousand troops; in seven days they galloped to Dongchuan and it did not fall;
translations.idiomatic: He first sent Regional Commander Wei Zhuguo with two thousand men; in seven days they reached Dongchuan and kept it from falling;

sentences.zh: 而魏翥國旋為祿鼎明刺傷，乃以官祿代翥國。

translations.literal: But Wei Zhuguo was soon stabbed and wounded by Lu Dingming; then the official Lu was put in Zhuguo's place.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhuguo was soon stabbed by Lu Dingming; an officer surnamed Lu then replaced him.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙委總兵哈元生、副將徐成貴，鎮雄委參將韓勳。

translations.literal: Wumeng was entrusted to Regional Commander Ha Yuansheng and Vice Commander Xu Chenggui; Zhenxiong to Assistant Regional Commander Han Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng was assigned to Regional Commander Ha Yuansheng and Vice Commander Xu Chenggui; Zhenxiong to Assistant Regional Commander Han Xun.

sentences.zh: 勳以兵四百扼奎鄉，敗賊四千，連破四寨。

translations.literal: Xun with four hundred troops held Kuixiang, defeated four thousand rebels, and in succession broke four stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xun held Kuixiang with four hundred men, routed four thousand rebels, and took four stockades in succession.

sentences.zh: 哈元生以千餘兵討烏蒙，先至得勝坡，遇賊二萬。

translations.literal: Ha Yuansheng with more than a thousand troops campaigned against Wumeng, first reaching Desheng Slope, where he met twenty thousand rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Ha Yuansheng marched on Wumeng with a little over a thousand men and first reached Desheng Slope, where he faced twenty thousand rebels.

sentences.zh: 其黑寡、暮末二渠皆萬人敵。

translations.literal: Their two chieftains Heiguo and Mumu were each a match for ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Their two leaders, Heiguo and Mumu, were each said to be a match for ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 黑寡持長槍，直犯元生，元生左格槍，右拔矢，應手殪之；

translations.literal: Heiguo wielded a long spear and charged straight at Yuansheng; Yuansheng parried the spear with his left hand, drew an arrow with his right, and at once killed him;
translations.idiomatic: Heiguo charged with a long spear; Yuansheng parried with his left hand, drew an arrow with his right, and killed him on the spot;

sentences.zh: 又射殪暮末，即竿揭二首以進，賊奪氣。

translations.literal: He also shot and killed Mumu, then immediately raised both heads on poles and advanced; the rebels lost their spirit.
translations.idiomatic: He shot Mumu dead as well, raised both heads on poles, and advanced; the rebels' morale collapsed.

sentences.zh: 再戰再捷，進至倚那岡。

translations.literal: Fighting again he won again, advancing to Yina Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: He fought again and won again, pushing forward to Yina Ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊數萬，連營十餘里。

translations.literal: The rebels numbered tens of thousands, their camps stretching more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of rebels had camps stretching more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 我兵三千、土兵千，夜設伏賊營左右，而嚴陣以待。

translations.literal: Our troops were three thousand, native troops one thousand; by night they set ambushes on both sides of the rebel camps while holding a strict battle line to await them.
translations.idiomatic: With three thousand regulars and a thousand native auxiliaries, they laid night ambushes on both flanks of the rebel camps while holding a tight battle line.

sentences.zh: 黎明，賊數路來犯，不動。

translations.literal: At dawn the rebels came to attack on several routes; our forces did not move.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the rebels attacked on several routes; our line held firm.

sentences.zh: 將偪陣，砲起，大呼奮擊，山后伏兵左右夾攻，賊大潰，盡破其八十餘營，獲甲械輜重山積。

translations.literal: When they were about to press the line, cannon fired, a great shout rose and they struck fiercely; ambush troops behind the mountain attacked from left and right; the rebels were utterly routed, all more than eighty camps were broken, and armor, weapons, and baggage were captured in mountains of piles.
translations.idiomatic: As the rebels closed in, cannon opened fire and our men charged with a great shout; ambushers behind the hill struck both flanks; the rebels broke completely; more than eighty camps were destroyed; armor, weapons, and baggage piled up like hills.

sentences.zh: 即日抵烏蒙，賊見元生旗，即反走，克三關，祿萬福兄弟、祿鼎坤均伏誅。

translations.literal: That same day they reached Wumeng; the rebels seeing Yuansheng's banner at once turned and fled; three passes were taken; Lu Wanfu and his brothers and Lu Dingkun were all executed according to law.
translations.idiomatic: That same day they reached Wumeng; at sight of Yuansheng's banner the rebels fled; three passes were taken; Lu Wanfu and his brothers and Lu Dingkun were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄂爾泰總督三省，其土州安於蕃、鎮沅土府刁澣，及赭樂長官土司、威遠州、廣南府各土目，先後劾黜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Ortai governed three provinces as governor-general; the native subprefecture of Anyufan, the native prefecture of Zhenyuan under Diao Huan, the Chashi chief native chieftain, and the various native headmen of Weiyuan Subprefecture and Guangnan Prefecture were in succession impeached and removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Ortai became governor-general of three provinces; the Anyufan native subprefecture, the Zhenyuan native prefecture under Diao Huan, the Chashi chief office, and native headmen in Weiyuan and Guangnan were removed one after another.

sentences.zh: 惟刁氏之族舍土目煽糾威遠黑倮復反，戕知府劉洪度。

translations.literal: Only clansmen of the Diao surname who had relinquished native headmanship incited and rallied the black Luo of Weiyuan to rebel again, killing Prefect Liu Hongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Former Diao clansmen stirred the black Yi of Weiyuan to rebel again and killed Prefect Liu Hongdu.

sentences.zh: 於是盡徙已革土司土目他省安置，並搜剿黨逆之威遠、新平諸倮，冒瘴突入，擒斬千計，而我將士亦患瘴死二百餘。

translations.literal: Thereupon all abolished native chieftains and headmen were wholly relocated and settled in other provinces, and the Luo of Weiyuan and Xinping who were party to rebellion were searched out and suppressed; braving miasma they burst in, capturing and beheading by the thousands, while our officers and soldiers also died of miasma more than two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: All deposed chieftains and headmen were resettled in other provinces; Yi rebels in Weiyuan and Xinping were hunted down; troops braved miasma and killed thousands, while more than two hundred of our own men died of the same pestilence.

sentences.zh: 又進剿瀾滄江內孟養、茶山土夷，即明王驥兵十二萬，大舉再征，諸蠻驚謂「自古漢兵所未至者」也。

translations.literal: They also advanced to suppress the Mengyang and Chashan native barbarians within the Lancang River—the very place where in the Ming Wang Ji with an army of one hundred twenty thousand had launched a great campaign a second time—and the various barbarians were startled, saying, "A place where Han troops since antiquity had never come."
translations.idiomatic: They also pushed into the Lancang basin against the Mengyang and Chashan tribes—the region where the Ming general Wang Ji had once led one hundred twenty thousand men on a second great campaign—where the tribes exclaimed that Han armies had never reached them before.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰先檄車里土兵截諸江外，官兵各持斧鍬開路，焚柵湮溝，連破險隘，直抵孟養，據蠻坡通餉道；

translations.literal: Ortai first ordered Cheli native troops to block all beyond the rivers; regular troops each held axes and spades to open roads, burned stockades and filled ditches, broke dangerous passes in succession, reached Mengyang straight through, and held Manpo to open the supply route;
translations.idiomatic: Ortai first sent Cheli native troops to seal the far side of the rivers; regulars cut roads with axes and spades, burned stockades and filled ditches, stormed pass after pass to Mengyang, and held Manpo to secure the supply line;

sentences.zh: 其六茶山巢穴四十餘寨，乃用降夷鄉導，以賊攻賊，於是深入數千里，無險不搜。

translations.literal: Their six Chashan lairs had more than forty stockades; then surrendered barbarians were used as local guides, using rebels to attack rebels; thus they penetrated several thousand li, and no defile went unsearched.
translations.idiomatic: Six Chashan strongholds held more than forty stockades; surrendered tribesmen served as guides and rebel bands were turned against one another; the army pushed thousands of li into country where no pass was left unsearched.

sentences.zh: 惟江外歸車里土司，江內地全改流。

translations.literal: Only lands beyond the river were returned to the Cheli native chieftain; all territory within the river was wholly converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: Only territory beyond the river remained under the Cheli chieftain; everything on the near bank was placed under regular administration.

sentences.zh: 升普洱為府；

translations.literal: Pu'er was promoted to a prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Pu'er was elevated to prefectural status;

sentences.zh: 移沅江協副將駐之。

translations.literal: the vice commander of the Yuanjiang garrison command was moved to station there.
translations.idiomatic: and the vice commander of the Yuanjiang garrison was posted there.

sentences.zh: 于思茅、橄欖壩各設官戍兵，以扼蒙緬、老撾門戶。

translations.literal: At Simao and Ganlanba officials and garrison troops were each established to choke the gateways to Meng-Mian and Laos.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and garrisons were placed at Simao and Ganlanba to guard the approaches to Burma and Laos.

sentences.zh: 於是廣南府土同知、富州土知州，各原增歲糧二三千石，並捐建府、州城垣。

translations.literal: Thereupon the native associate prefect of Guangnan Prefecture and the native prefect of Fuzhou each voluntarily added two or three thousand piculs of annual grain tax and also donated construction of prefectural and departmental city walls.
translations.idiomatic: The native associate prefect of Guangnan and the native prefect of Fuzhou each pledged an extra two or three thousand piculs of annual grain and helped fund new city walls.

sentences.zh: 孟連土司獻銀廠，怒江野夷輸皮幣，而老撾、景邁二國皆來貢象，緬甸震焉。

translations.literal: The Menglian native chieftain presented a silver mine; wild barbarians of the Nujiang submitted hides and currency; and the two states of Laos and Jingmai all came to offer tribute elephants; Burma was shaken thereby.
translations.idiomatic: The Menglian chieftain offered a silver mine; wild tribes of the Nujiang paid tribute in hides; Laos and Jingmai sent elephants; and Burma was shaken.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十四年，遷孟拱土司於關外。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year of Qianlong the Menggong native chieftain was relocated beyond the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year of the Qianlong reign the Menggong chieftain was moved beyond the frontier pass.

sentences.zh: 緬甸事詳見緬甸傳。

translations.literal: Matters of Burma are detailed in the Burma biography.
translations.idiomatic: Burma is treated in full in the Burma biography.

sentences.zh: 煉象關土巡檢，居煉象關大街。

translations.literal: The native subprefectural inspector of Lianxiang Pass resided on the main street of Lianxiang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Lianxiang Pass had his seat on the pass's main street.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢李文秀歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Li Wenxiu submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Li Wenxiu submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至李東祚，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Dongzuo; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Dongzuo; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 南平關土巡檢，居土官村。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Nanping Pass resided at Tuguan Village.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Nanping Pass resided at Tuguan Village.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢李楚南歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Li Chunan submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Li Chunan submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至李東來，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Donglai; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Donglai; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 定西嶺土巡檢，居定西嶺。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Dingxi Ridge resided at Dingxi Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Dingxi Ridge resided at Dingxi Ridge.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢李齊鬥歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Li Qidou submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Li Qidou submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 雲南縣土縣丞，在縣城。

translations.literal: The native assistant magistrate of Yunnan County was in the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The native assistant magistrate of Yunnan County was seated in the county town.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土知縣楊玉蘊子嶽歸附，仍授土知縣世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native magistrate Yang Yulan's son Yue submitted and was again granted the hereditary post of native magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Yang Yulan's son Yue submitted and kept the hereditary native magistracy.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，雲南縣改設流官知縣，其知縣改縣丞，世襲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi Yunnan County was changed to establish a regular magistrate; the former magistrate was changed to assistant magistrate, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Kangxi a regular magistrate was installed at Yunnan County and the former native magistrate became a hereditary assistant magistrate.

sentences.zh: 雲南縣土主簿，居土官村，離城十里。

translations.literal: The native registrar of Yunnan County resided at Tuguan Village, ten li from the city.
translations.idiomatic: The native registrar of Yunnan County lived at Tuguan Village, ten li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土主簿張維歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native registrar Zhang Wei submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native registrar Zhang Wei submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 青索鼻土巡檢，在青索鼻。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Qingsuobi was at Qingsuobi.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Qingsuobi was posted at Qingsuobi.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊應鵬歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Yang Yingpeng submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Yang Yingpeng submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至楊榮昌，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Yang Rongchang; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Yang Rongchang; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 浪穹縣土典史，在縣城。

translations.literal: The native archivist of Langqiong County was in the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The native archivist of Langqiong County was seated in the county town.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土典史王鳳州歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native archivist Wang Fengzhou submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native archivist Wang Fengzhou submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 蒲陀崆土巡檢，在蒲陀崆，距縣城十五里。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Putuokong was at Putuokong, fifteen li from the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Putuokong was posted at Putuokong, fifteen li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊爭先歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Yang Zhengxian submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Yang Zhengxian submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 鳳羽鄉土巡檢，在鳳羽鄉，距縣城三十里。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Fengyu Township was at Fengyu Township, thirty li from the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Fengyu Township was posted at Fengyu, thirty li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢尹德明歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Yin Deming submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Yin Deming submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 上江嘴土巡檢，在上江嘴，距縣一百二十里。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Shangjiangzui was at Shangjiangzui, one hundred twenty li from the county.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Shangjiangzui was posted at Shangjiangzui, one hundred twenty li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊康國歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Yang Kangguo submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Yang Kangguo submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 下江嘴土巡檢，在下江嘴，距縣九十里。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Xiajiangzui was at Xiajiangzui, ninety li from the county.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Xiajiangzui was posted at Xiajiangzui, ninety li from the county seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢何應福歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector He Yingfu submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector He Yingfu submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 箭杆場土巡檢，居箭杆場。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Jiangan Field resided at Jiangan Field.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Jiangan Field was seated at Jiangan Field.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢字題鳳歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Zi Tifeng submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Zi Tifeng submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 舊屬鄧川州，康熙二年，改隸雲龍州。

translations.literal: Formerly subordinate to Dengchuan Prefecture; in the second year of Kangxi it was changed to be subordinate to Yunlong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly under Dengchuan Prefecture; in the second year of Kangxi it was transferred to Yunlong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二關長官司，在府東三百里。

translations.literal: The chief office of the Twelve Passes was three hundred li east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office of the Twelve Passes lay three hundred li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司李恬森歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the chief office-holder Li Tiansen submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Chief Li Tiansen submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 老窩土千總，居老窩。

translations.literal: The native battalion commander of Laowo resided at Laowo.
translations.idiomatic: The native battalion commander of Laowo was seated at Laowo.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土知州段德壽歸附，後裁。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native prefect Duan Deshou submitted; later the post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native prefect Duan Deshou submitted; the office was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，德壽孫維精剿秤戛夷賊有功，十七年，授土千總世職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong Deshou's grandson Weijing had merit in suppressing the Chengga barbarian rebels; in the seventeenth year he was granted the hereditary post of native battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Qianlong Deshou's grandson Weijing helped suppress the Chengga rebels; in the seventeenth year he received the hereditary battalion command.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，永北軍務，段克勳帶練擒賊，給五品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, during the Yongbei military affair, Duan Kexun led militia to capture rebels and was given a fifth-rank official cap button.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang, during operations at Yongbei, Duan Kexun led militia to capture rebels and was awarded a fifth-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 六庫土千總，居六庫。

translations.literal: The native battalion commander of Liuku resided at Liuku.
translations.idiomatic: The native battalion commander of Liuku was seated at Liuku.

sentences.zh: 其先段復健，明土知州段保十七世孫。

translations.literal: His ancestor was Duan Fujian, seventeenth-generation descendant of the Ming native prefect Duan Bao.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor Duan Fujian was the seventeenth-generation descendant of the Ming native prefect Duan Bao.

sentences.zh: 清乾隆十二年，征秤戛夷賊有功，十七年，授土千總世職。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong of the Qing he had merit campaigning against the Chengga barbarian rebels; in the seventeenth year he was granted the hereditary post of native battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Qianlong he served against the Chengga rebels with distinction; in the seventeenth year he received the hereditary battalion command.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，永北軍務，段履仁帶練擒賊，給五品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, during the Yongbei military affair, Duan Lvren led militia to capture rebels and was given a fifth-rank official cap button.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang, during operations at Yongbei, Duan Lvren led militia to capture rebels and was awarded a fifth-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 漕澗土把總，居漕澗。

translations.literal: The native company commander of Caojian resided at Caojian.
translations.idiomatic: The native company commander of Caojian was seated at Caojian.

sentences.zh: 清順治十八年，左文燦以堵禦功授土官長官司，子停襲。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Zuo Wencan was granted the native chief office for merit in blocking the enemy; succession by his son was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi Zuo Wencan received the native chief office for blocking the enemy; his son's succession was suspended.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十二年，文燦曾孫左世英隨征秤戛夷賊有功，授土把總，世襲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Qianlong Wencan's great-grandson Zuo Shiying had merit following the campaign against the Chengga barbarian rebels and was granted the post of native company commander, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Qianlong Wencan's great-grandson Zuo Shiying served against the Chengga rebels with distinction and received the hereditary company command.

sentences.zh: 鄧川州土知州，清順治十六年，土知州阿尚夔歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Dengchuan Prefecture: in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native prefect A Shangkui submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Dengchuan: in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi A Shangkui submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 曾孫阿口遠，因縱賊殃民，雍正四年改流，安插江西。

translations.literal: His great-grandson A Kouyuan, because he indulged bandits and harmed the people, in the fourth year of Yongzheng was converted to regular administration and resettled in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson A Kouyuan indulged bandits and harmed the people; in the fourth year of Yongzheng the post was abolished and he was resettled in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 納樓茶甸長官司，在府西南一百八十里。

translations.literal: The chief office of Nalou Chadian was one hundred eighty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office of Nalou Chadian lay one hundred eighty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司普率歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Chief Pu Shuai submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Chief Pu Shuai submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，率附王祿叛，官兵討之，乞降，赦之，以子向化襲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi Shuai followed Wang Lu in rebellion; government troops campaigned against him; he begged to surrender and was pardoned; his son Xianghua succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi Shuai joined Wang Lu's rebellion; government troops attacked; he surrendered and was pardoned; his son Xianghua inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 納更山土巡檢，距府東南二百八十里。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Nageng Mountain was two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Nageng Mountain was posted two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢龍天正歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Long Tianzheng submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Long Tianzheng submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 虧容甸長官司，在府西南一百四十里。

translations.literal: The chief office of Kuirongdian was one hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office of Kuirongdian lay one hundred forty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司孫大昌歸附，仍授副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Chief Sun Dachang submitted and was again granted the hereditary post of associate chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Chief Sun Dachang submitted and kept the hereditary associate chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 思陀鄉土舍，在府西南二百五十里。

translations.literal: The native headman of Situo Township was two hundred fifty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of Situo Township was seated two hundred fifty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司李秉忠歸附，仍授長官司、副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Chief Li Bingzhong submitted and was again granted the hereditary posts of chief office and associate chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Chief Li Bingzhong submitted and kept the hereditary chief and associate chieftaincies.

sentences.zh: 後絕，改土舍。

translations.literal: Later the line died out; it was changed to a native headmanship.
translations.idiomatic: The line later died out and the post became a native headmanship.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十年，以李世元繼襲。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kangxi Li Shiyuan was made to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Kangxi Li Shiyuan inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 溪處長官司副長官，在府西南三百一十五里。

translations.literal: The associate chief of the Xichu chief office was three hundred fifteen li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The associate chief of the Xichu chief office was posted three hundred fifteen li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，長官司恩忠歸附，仍授副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Chief Enzhong submitted and was again granted the hereditary post of associate chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Chief Enzhong submitted and kept the hereditary associate chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，附祿昌賢叛，伏誅，改土舍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he followed Lu Changxian in rebellion, was executed according to law, and the post was changed to a native headmanship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Lu Changxian's rebellion, was executed, and the office became a native headmanship.

sentences.zh: 瓦渣鄉長官司，在府西南二百四十里。

translations.literal: The chief office of Wazha Township was two hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office of Wazha Township lay two hundred forty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，錢覺耀歸附，仍授副長官世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Qian Jueyao submitted and was again granted the hereditary post of associate chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Qian Jueyao submitted and kept the hereditary associate chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，通王祿叛，官兵擒斬之，職除，改土舍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he communicated with Wang Lu in rebellion; government troops captured and beheaded him; the office was abolished and changed to a native headmanship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he colluded with Wang Lu; government troops captured and executed him; the office was abolished and replaced by a native headmanship.

sentences.zh: 左能寨長官司，在府西南二百三十里。

translations.literal: The chief office of Zuoneng Stockade was two hundred thirty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office of Zuoneng Stockade lay two hundred thirty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，吳應科歸附，以非滇志所載，下臨安府查核，稽其譜系，蓋應科為明蚌頗十一世孫，因改土舍，准襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Wu Yingke submitted; because he was not recorded in the Yunnan gazetteer, the case was sent down to Lin'an Prefecture for verification; tracing his genealogy, Yingke was in fact the eleventh-generation descendant of the Ming [chief] Bangpo; therefore it was changed to a native headmanship and succession was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Wu Yingke submitted; as he was not listed in the Yunnan gazetteer, Lin'an Prefecture verified his genealogy and found him to be the eleventh-generation descendant of the Ming chieftain Bangpo; the post became a native headmanship with permission to inherit.

sentences.zh: 落恐甸長官司，在府西南二百里。

translations.literal: The chief office of Luokongdian was two hundred li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The chief office of Luokongdian lay two hundred li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，明授副長官司陳玉歸附，因號紙無存，給便委土舍，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Chen Yu, granted the associate chief office in the Ming, submitted; because the patent document no longer existed, he was given a provisional appointment as native headman, while hereditary succession was still permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Chen Yu, Ming-appointed associate chief, submitted; as his patent was lost, he received a provisional native headmanship while hereditary succession was still allowed.

sentences.zh: 阿邦鄉土舍，在府東南二百一十里。

translations.literal: The native headman of Abang Township was two hundred ten li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of Abang Township was seated two hundred ten li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 明授土守備。

translations.literal: In the Ming he was granted the post of native garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming he held the post of native garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土守備陶順祖歸附，守職如故。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native garrison commander Tao Shunzu submitted and guarded his post as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native garrison commander Tao Shunzu submitted and retained his duties.

sentences.zh: 旋議土司不宜加武職，改土舍。

translations.literal: Soon it was debated that native chieftains should not be given military posts; it was changed to a native headmanship.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon decided that native chieftains should not hold military titles; the post became a native headmanship.

sentences.zh: 慢車鄉土舍，在府西南一百四十里。

translations.literal: The native headman of Manche Township was one hundred forty li southwest of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native headman of Manche Township was seated one hundred forty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治間，元江土夷亂，漫車土目刀岡隨官軍協剿，授土舍世職。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi of the Qing, when the native barbarians of Yuanjiang rebelled, the Manche native headman Dao Gang followed government troops in joint suppression and was granted the hereditary post of native headman.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign, when Yuanjiang tribes rebelled, the Manche headman Dao Gang aided government troops and received the hereditary headmanship.

sentences.zh: 稿吾卡土把總，在府東南二百八十里。

translations.literal: The native company commander of Gaowuka was two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native company commander of Gaowuka was posted two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清雍正間，納更土目龍在渭隨征元普逆夷有功，給土把總職銜。

translations.literal: During Yongzhi of the Qing, the Nageng native headman Long Zaiwei had merit following the campaign against the rebellious barbarians of Yuanpu and was given the title of native company commander.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign the Nageng headman Long Zaiwei served against the Yuanpu rebels with distinction and received the rank of native company commander.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十二年，江外夷匪滋事，龍定國父子陣亡，奏准世襲土把總。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jiaqing, when barbarian bandits beyond the river made trouble, Long Dingguo and his son died in battle; a memorial was approved granting the hereditary post of native company commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Jiaqing, when bandits beyond the river rose up, Long Dingguo and his son fell in battle; the court approved the hereditary company command.

sentences.zh: 十五猛，縱橫四百餘里。

translations.literal: The Fifteen Meng extended more than four hundred li in length and breadth.
translations.idiomatic: The Fifteen Meng covered more than four hundred li in every direction.

sentences.zh: 明初為沐氏勳莊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Ming it was a merit estate of the Mu clan.
translations.idiomatic: In early Ming times it was a merit estate of the Mu clan.

sentences.zh: 清順治十七年，吳三桂請並雲南荒田給與籓下壯丁耕種。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Wu Sangui requested that Yunnan's wasteland be combined and given to strong men under the princely establishment for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Shunzhi Wu Sangui asked that Yunnan's wasteland be granted to men of the princely household for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年，奏旨圈撥。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi an imperial memorial decree ordered it circled and allocated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Kangxi an imperial order reclaimed the land.

sentences.zh: 叛後，變價歸建水徵收。

translations.literal: After the rebellion it was sold for cash and placed under collection by Jianshui.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion it was sold off and its revenue assigned to Jianshui.

sentences.zh: 猛各設一掌寨，督辦錢糧。

translations.literal: Each meng had one stockade chief established to supervise tax grain and money.
translations.idiomatic: Each meng had a stockade chief to oversee tax collection.

sentences.zh: 管有猛喇、猛丁、猛梭、猛賴、猛蚌、茨桶壩、五畝、五邦、者米、猛弄、馬龍、瓦遮、鬥岩、阿土、水塘十五寨。

translations.literal: It administered fifteen stockades: Mengla, Mengding, Mengsuo, Menglai, Mengbang, Citongba, Wumu, Wubang, Zhemi, Mengnong, Malong, Wazhe, Douyan, Atu, and Shuitang.
translations.idiomatic: It governed fifteen stockades: Mengla, Mengding, Mengsuo, Menglai, Mengbang, Citongba, Wumu, Wubang, Zhemi, Mengnong, Malong, Wazhe, Douyan, Atu, and Shuitang.

sentences.zh: 教化三部長官副長官。

translations.literal: Associate chief of the three departments of Jiaohua.
translations.idiomatic: The associate chief of the three Jiaohua departments.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，副長官龍升歸附，仍以張長壽為名，許之，授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Associate Chief Long Sheng submitted; he still used the name Zhang Changshou; this was permitted and he was granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Associate Chief Long Sheng submitted under the name Zhang Changshou; the court accepted this and granted the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，附王祿叛，誅之，以其地為開化府，設流官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he followed Wang Lu in rebellion and was executed; his territory was made Kaifu Prefecture and regular officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Wang Lu's rebellion and was executed; his territory became Kaifu Prefecture under regular administration.

sentences.zh: 王弄山長官司副長官。

translations.literal: Associate chief of the Wangnongshan chief office.
translations.idiomatic: The associate chief of the Wangnongshan chief office.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，副長官王朔歸附，授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Associate Chief Wang Shuo submitted and was granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Associate Chief Wang Shuo submitted and received the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，朔與祿昌賢叛，官兵討之，朔自焚死，以其地屬開化府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi Shuo rebelled with Lu Changxian; government troops campaigned against them; Shuo burned himself to death; his territory was placed under Kaifu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi Shuo joined Lu Changxian in rebellion; government troops attacked; Shuo committed suicide by fire; his territory was annexed to Kaifu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 阿迷州土知州，舊有土目李阿側。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Ami Prefecture: formerly there was the native headman Li Ace.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Ami Prefecture: formerly the native headman Li Ace held sway.

sentences.zh: 清康熙四年，從討王朔有功，授土知州世職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi of the Qing he had merit following the campaign against Wang Shuo and was granted the hereditary post of native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he served against Wang Shuo with distinction and received the hereditary native prefecture.

sentences.zh: 傳至李純，濫派橫征，為倮夷所控。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Chun, who levied excessive arbitrary taxes and was controlled by the Luo Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Chun, who imposed arbitrary levies until the Yi brought charges against him.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，籍其產，安置江西，改流。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng his property was registered, he was resettled in Jiangxi, and the post was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongzheng his estates were confiscated, he was resettled in Jiangxi, and regular administration was installed.

sentences.zh: 寧州土知州，清順治十六年，祿昌賢歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Ningzhou: in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Lu Changxian submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Ningzhou: in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Lu Changxian submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 十七年，降州同。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was demoted to department vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was demoted to department vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 明年，以舉首梅道人等謀逆，復原職。

translations.literal: The next year, because he reported the Daoist Mei Daoren and others plotting rebellion, his former post was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he exposed a plot by the Daoist Mei Daoren and others and was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，以叛伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he was executed according to law for rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he was executed for rebellion.

sentences.zh: 寧州土州判。

translations.literal: The native department judge of Ningzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The native department judge of Ningzhou.

sentences.zh: 清康熙十九年，滇有李者祿歸附，准世襲州判。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Kangxi of the Qing, when Yunnan was recovered, Li Zhelu of Yunnan submitted and was permitted hereditary succession as department judge.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Kangxi, when Yunnan was recovered, Li Zhelu submitted and was granted the hereditary department judgeship.

sentences.zh: 後絕，停襲。

translations.literal: Later the line died out and succession was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: The line later died out and succession ceased.

sentences.zh: 嶍峨縣土知縣。

translations.literal: The native magistrate of Xie'e County.
translations.idiomatic: The native magistrate of Xie'e County.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，祿益歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Lu Yi submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Lu Yi submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，與祿昌賢等叛改流。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he rebelled with Lu Changxian and others and was converted to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Lu Changxian's rebellion and the post was abolished in favor of regular administration.

sentences.zh: 嶍峨縣土主簿。

translations.literal: The native registrar of Xie'e County.
translations.idiomatic: The native registrar of Xie'e County.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，王揚祖歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Wang Yangzu submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Wang Yangzu submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，與祿昌賢等叛，伏誅，職除。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he rebelled with Lu Changxian and others, was executed according to law, and the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Lu Changxian's rebellion, was executed, and the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 蒙自縣土縣丞。

translations.literal: The native assistant magistrate of Mengzi County.
translations.idiomatic: The native assistant magistrate of Mengzi County.

sentences.zh: 土知縣陸氏被黜，其土舍寧州祿重據土官村，溺於酒色，不能馭下。

translations.literal: The native magistrate of the Lu clan was dismissed; the native headman Lu Chong of Ningzhou seized Tuguan Village, drowned in wine and women, and could not control his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: The Lu native magistrate was removed; the Ningzhou headman Lu Chong seized Tuguan Village, indulged in wine and women, and lost control of his followers.

sentences.zh: 其目把李輔舜等叛歸沙源，源以兵乘之，遂破有土官村。

translations.literal: His subordinate headmen Li Fushun and others rebelled and went over to Sha Yuan; Yuan took advantage with troops and thereupon broke and held Tuguan Village.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinates Li Fushun and others defected to Sha Yuan, who attacked and seized Tuguan Village.

sentences.zh: 沙定洲踞會城，令李輔舜子日芳竊據蒙自。

translations.literal: Sha Dingzhou occupied the provincial capital and ordered Li Fushun's son Rifang to seize Mengzi by stealth.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Dingzhou held the provincial capital and sent Li Fushun's son Rifang to seize Mengzi.

sentences.zh: 定洲敗，日芳遂家於蒙。

translations.literal: Dingzhou was defeated; Rifang then made his home in Meng.
translations.idiomatic: When Dingzhou fell, Rifang settled his family in Mengzi.

sentences.zh: 清康熙四年，日芳弟日森子世籓、世屏附寧州祿昌賢叛，總兵閻鎮破之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi of the Qing, Rifang's younger brother Risun's sons Shifan and Shiping followed Ningzhou's Lu Changxian in rebellion; Regional Commander Yan Zhen defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi Risun's sons Shifan and Shiping joined Lu Changxian of Ningzhou in rebellion; Regional Commander Yan Zhen defeated them.

sentences.zh: 世籓遁，追斬之；

translations.literal: Shifan fled and was pursued and beheaded;
translations.idiomatic: Shifan fled and was hunted down and killed;

sentences.zh: 世屏出降，免死，充大理軍。

translations.literal: Shiping came out and surrendered, was spared death, and was enrolled in the Dali army.
translations.idiomatic: Shiping surrendered, was spared, and enrolled in the Dali garrison.

sentences.zh: 後吳三桂反，給世屏偽總兵劄。

translations.literal: Later when Wu Sangui rebelled, Shiping was given a false commission as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui later rebelled, Shiping received a forged commission as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 大師復滇，世屏持劄歸附，授蒙自縣土縣丞職，不准世襲。

translations.literal: When the Great Army recovered Yunnan, Shiping presented his commission and submitted; he was granted the post of native assistant magistrate of Mengzi County, without permission for hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army recovered Yunnan, Shiping submitted with his commission and was made native assistant magistrate of Mengzi, without hereditary right.

sentences.zh: 楚雄縣土縣丞。

translations.literal: The native assistant magistrate of Chuxiong County.
translations.idiomatic: The native assistant magistrate of Chuxiong County.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土縣丞楊春盛歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native assistant magistrate Yang Chunsheng submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native assistant magistrate Yang Chunsheng submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年，改為正八品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to an eighth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary eighth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 鎮南州土州同，居本城。

translations.literal: The native department vice prefect of Zhennan Prefecture resided in the main city.
translations.idiomatic: The native department vice prefect of Zhennan was seated in the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土州同段光贊歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native department vice prefect Duan Guangzan submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native department vice prefect Duan Guangzan submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 鎮南州土州判，居鎮南州城東北。

translations.literal: The native department judge of Zhennan Prefecture resided northeast of Zhennan Prefecture city.
translations.idiomatic: The native department judge of Zhennan was seated northeast of the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土州判陳昌虞歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native department judge Chen Changyu submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native department judge Chen Changyu submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 阿雄關土巡檢，居鎮南州屬。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Axiong Pass resided in a place subordinate to Zhennan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Axiong Pass was posted within Zhennan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢者光祖歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Zhe Guangzu submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Zhe Guangzu submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 鎮南關土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Zhennan Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Zhennan Pass.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊繼祖歸附，仍授舊職，傳至楊文輝，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Yang Jizu submitted and was again granted his former post; the line passed to Yang Wenhui; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Yang Jizu submitted and retained his office; the line reached Yang Wenhui; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 姚州土州同，居姚州西界彌興官莊。

translations.literal: The native department vice prefect of Yaozhou resided at the Mixing official manor on Yaozhou's western border.
translations.idiomatic: The native department vice prefect of Yaozhou was seated at the Mixing official manor on the prefecture's western border.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土州同高顯錫歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native department vice prefect Gao Xianxi submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native department vice prefect Gao Xianxi submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至高配忝，乾隆五十年，改為從六品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Gao Peitian; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a sixth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Gao Peitian; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary sixth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 回磴關土巡檢，居回磴關。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Huideng Pass resided at Huideng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Huideng Pass was posted at Huideng Pass.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢楊忠藎歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Yang Zhongjin submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Yang Zhongjin submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至楊怡，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Yang Yi; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Yang Yi; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 沙矣舊土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Shayiji.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Shayiji.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢蘇鑒歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Su Jian submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Su Jian submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至蘇敬，乾隆五十年，改為從九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Su Jing; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Su Jing; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 定遠縣土主簿，居本城。

translations.literal: The native registrar of Dingyuan County resided in the main city.
translations.idiomatic: The native registrar of Dingyuan County was seated in the county town.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土主簿李世卿歸附，仍授舊職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native registrar Li Shiqing submitted and was again granted his former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native registrar Li Shiqing submitted and retained his former office.

sentences.zh: 傳至李毓英，乾隆五十年，改為正九品土官，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Yuying; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong it was changed to a ninth-rank native official of the upper grade, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Yuying; in the fiftieth year of Qianlong the post became a hereditary upper ninth-rank native official.

sentences.zh: 姚安府土同知。

translations.literal: The native associate prefect of Yao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native associate prefect of Yao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土同知高奣映歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native associate prefect Gao Benying submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native associate prefect Gao Benying submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 傳至李厚德，雍正三年，以不法革職，安置江南。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Houde; in the third year of Yongzheng he was dismissed for unlawful conduct and resettled in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Li Houde; in the third year of Yongzheng he was removed for misconduct and resettled in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 新興州土州判，居州南研和邑。

translations.literal: The native department judge of Xinxing Prefecture resided at Yanhe district south of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native department judge of Xinxing was seated at Yanhe, south of the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 清康熙十九年，復滇，土人王鳳授偽遊擊，迎至廣西路投誠；

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Kangxi of the Qing, when Yunnan was recovered, the native Wang Feng had been given a false commission as guerrilla commander; he was welcomed to the Guangxi route to offer submission;
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Kangxi, when Yunnan was recovered, the local leader Wang Feng, who had held a rebel guerrilla commission, was received on the Guangxi route to submit;

sentences.zh: 隨征石門檻、馬別河、黃草壩皆有功，授土州判世職。

translations.literal: He had merit on campaigns at Shimenkan, Mabie River, and Huangcaoba, and was granted the hereditary post of native department judge.
translations.idiomatic: He served with distinction at Shimenkan, the Mabie River, and Huangcaoba and received the hereditary department judgeship.

sentences.zh: 河陽縣安插土官。

translations.literal: The resettled native official of Heyang County.
translations.idiomatic: The resettled native official of Heyang County.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，土官刀韜歸附，止給劄，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi of the Qing the native official Dao Tao submitted; he was only given a commission, while hereditary succession was still permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shunzhi reign the native official Dao Tao submitted; he received only a commission but was allowed to inherit the post.

sentences.zh: 沿至刀廷俊，裁革。

translations.literal: Continuing down to Dao Tingjun, the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The line continued until Dao Tingjun, when the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 鐵爐關土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Tielu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Tielu Pass.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢王先榮歸附，授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Wang Xianrong submitted and was granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Wang Xianrong submitted and received the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，同王耀祖叛，削除。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he rebelled together with Wang Yaozu and the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he joined Wang Yaozu in rebellion and the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 廣南府土同知。

translations.literal: The native associate prefect of Guangnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native associate prefect of Guangnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，儂鵬歸附，授同知世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing Nong Peng submitted and was granted the hereditary post of associate prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi Nong Peng submitted and received the hereditary associate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 傳至儂毓榮，乾隆三十一年，從征普洱、緬甸。

translations.literal: The line passed to Nong Yurong; in the thirty-first year of Qianlong he followed campaigns in Pu'er and Burma.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Nong Yurong, who in the thirty-first year of Qianlong served in campaigns in Pu'er and Burma.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，頒給土同知關防。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year the official seal of the native associate prefect was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he received the official seal of the native associate prefect.

sentences.zh: 子世昌，嘉慶二年從征貴州仲苗，加銜一等，賞戴花翎，世襲。

translations.literal: His son Shichang in the second year of Jiaqing followed the campaign against the Zhong Miao of Guizhou; his rank was raised one grade; he was rewarded with the peacock feather; succession was hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shichang served against the Zhong Miao of Guizhou in the second year of Jiaqing, was promoted one rank, awarded the peacock feather, and granted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 富州土知州，在府東二百六十五里。

translations.literal: The native prefect of Fuzhou was two hundred sixty-five li east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native prefect of Fuzhou lay two hundred sixty-five li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土知州沈昆巘歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native prefect Shen Kunyan submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native prefect Shen Kunyan submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，頒給州印。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi the departmental seal was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Kangxi the departmental seal was issued.

sentences.zh: 後以罪黜，傳至沈肇乾。

translations.literal: Later he was dismissed for a crime; the line passed to Shen Zhaoqian.
translations.idiomatic: He was later removed for misconduct; the line reached Shen Zhaoqian.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，肇乾復以罪黜。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng Zhaoqian was again dismissed for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yongzheng Zhaoqian was again removed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 大猛麻土巡檢。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Damengma.
translations.idiomatic: The native inspector of Damengma.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，土巡檢俸新命歸附，仍授世職。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi of the Qing the native inspector Feng Xinming submitted and was again granted the hereditary post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi the native inspector Feng Xinming submitted and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 猛猛土巡檢，明末奔竄，失其印信號紙，未能請襲。

translations.literal: The native inspector of Mengmeng: at the end of the Ming he fled in disorder, lost his seal and patent document, and could not request succession.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengmeng native inspector fled at the end of the Ming, lost his seal and patent, and could not secure succession.

sentences.zh: 傳子紫芝，清康熙五十四年歸附，貢象，仍授世職，頒給鈐記。

translations.literal: His son Zizhi in the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi of the Qing submitted, offered tribute elephants, was again granted the hereditary post, and was issued an official chop.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zizhi submitted in the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi, presented tribute elephants, recovered the hereditary office, and received an official chop.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十九年，改屬順寧府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong jurisdiction was changed to Shunning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong it was transferred to Shunning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 孟連宣撫司，在順甯府邊外南境，舊隸於永昌府。

translations.literal: The Menglian pacification superintendency was on the southern frontier beyond Shunning Prefecture and was formerly subordinate to Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Menglian pacification superintendency lay on the southern frontier beyond Shunning and had formerly been under Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清康熙四十八年，刁派鼎貢象，歸附，授宣撫司世職。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Kangxi of the Qing Diao Pai Ding presented tribute elephants, submitted, and was granted the hereditary post of pacification superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year of Kangxi Diao Pai Ding presented tribute elephants, submitted, and received the hereditary pacification superintendency.

sentences.zh: 派鼎死，子刁派春年幼，叔祖刁派烈撫孤。

translations.literal: Pai Ding died; his son Diao Pai Chun was young; the paternal uncle Diao Pai Lie raised the orphan.
translations.idiomatic: When Pai Ding died, his young son Diao Pai Chun was raised by his great-uncle Diao Pai Lie.

sentences.zh: 有刁派猷謀殺派烈，奪印爭職，安插省城，另給宣撫司鈐記便委。

translations.literal: There was Diao Pai You, who plotted to kill Pai Lie, seized the seal and contended for the office; he was resettled in the provincial capital; another official chop of the pacification superintendency was given for provisional appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Diao Pai You plotted to kill Pai Lie and seize the office; he was resettled in the provincial capital while a provisional chop for the superintendency was issued.

sentences.zh: 傳至刁派新，因地處極邊，界連外域，定為經制宣撫司，頒給印信號紙。

translations.literal: The line passed to Diao Pai Xin; because the place was at the extreme frontier and its borders joined foreign territory, it was fixed as a regular pacification superintendency and the seal and patent document were issued.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Diao Pai Xin; because the domain lay on the outer frontier adjoining foreign lands, it was made a regular pacification superintendency with full seal and patent.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十九年，改隸順寧府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong it was changed to be subordinate to Shunning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of Qianlong it was placed under Shunning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 猛緬長官司，清乾隆十一年，歸流，改其地為緬寧，設流官通判駐其地。

translations.literal: The chief office of Mengmian: in the eleventh year of Qianlong of the Qing it was converted to regular administration; its territory was changed to Mianning; a regular subprefect was established and stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengmian chief office: in the eleventh year of Qianlong it was abolished; the territory became Mianning under a regular subprefect.

sentences.zh: 平彝縣土縣丞，居平彝縣竹園村。

translations.literal: The native assistant magistrate of Pingyi County resided at Zhuyuan Village in Pingyi County.
translations.idiomatic: The native assistant magistrate of Pingyi County was seated at Zhuyuan Village.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，土縣丞龍闊歸附，仍舊世襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi of the Qing the native assistant magistrate Long Kuo submitted and hereditary succession continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shunzhi reign the native assistant magistrate Long Kuo submitted and kept the hereditary office.
